extracted.intended_audience: public information officers (PIOs), emergency managers, and prospective PIO trainees in Utah (and related FEMA/NDPTC course attendees)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on where and how PIOs can obtain required and recommended training (Utah DEM offerings, FEMA independent study and resident courses, NDPTC offerings), including registration details, prerequisites, and scheduling notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of in-person PIO training by Utah DEM
rubrics_metrics.description: The Division of Emergency Management provides in-person PIO training throughout the state, based on need, availability of instructors, and support of the DEM Training and Exercise Section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the DEM training calendar for offerings; in-person classes occur when there is demonstrated need, instructor availability, and Training & Exercise Section support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended FEMA Independent Study (IS) courses for PIOs
rubrics_metrics.description: Independent study courses from FEMA that are recommended for PIOs, including: IS-29 PIO Awareness; IS-42 Social Media in Emergency Management; IS-240 Leadership and Influence; IS-241 Decision Making and Problem Solving; IS-242 Effective Communication; IS-702.a NIMS Public Information Systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These FEMA IS courses are available as independent study — see the full list under 'All FEMA Independent Study (IS) courses' for additional options and access instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic PIO (G-290) — classroom course & registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic PIO (G290) is listed as a classroom course; sign up on UTRAIN, course number 1011053.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Division of Emergency Management training calendar for scheduled classroom offerings. Note: FEMA has transitioned away from G-290 (see L-105 entry). DEM may still offer G-290 as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: JIS/JIC Planning (G-291) — classroom course & registration
rubrics_metrics.description: JIS/JIC Planning (G291) is listed as a classroom course; sign up on UTRAIN, course number 1020466.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the DEM training calendar for scheduling. Be aware FEMA replaced some legacy courses with newer alternatives (see L-105).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of UTRAIN and DEM/FEMA training calendars for registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Classroom course sign-up occurs via UTRAIN and training calendars: Basic PIO and JIS/JIC courses list UTRAIN course numbers; the page repeatedly directs users to the DEM training calendar and FEMA course pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided UTRAIN course numbers and the DEM/FEMA calendars to find dates, locations, and registration links.

rubrics_metrics.name: FEMA Public Information Basics (L-105) as replacement for G-290/G-291
rubrics_metrics.description: FEMA no longer supports the G-290 and G-291 courses; they have been replaced with the new L-105 Public Information Basics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: L-105 is a FEMA-authorized course whose availability will vary; it is required for the Emergency Management Basic Academy and is in demand, so course offerings may fill up quickly. Plan accordingly and check the FEMA L-105 information page for offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced PIO (E388) — prerequisites and lead time
rubrics_metrics.description: The Advanced PIO Course (E388) has various prerequisite courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the listed prerequisite courses (link referenced). You need to plan about six months ahead to attend — factor in prerequisites, application/registration timing, and limited seats when scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced PIO: Health and Hospital Emergencies (MGT-902) — provider/location
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced PIO: Health and Hospital Emergencies (MGT-902) is offered at the Center for Domestic Preparedness (Anniston, AL).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a specialized advanced course for health/hospital emergency PIO needs — check the Center for Domestic Preparedness for schedule and application details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master PIO (E389, E393, E394) — application requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Master PIO training consists of E389, E393 and E394 at the Emergency Management Institute (Emmitsburg, MD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are application requirements for Master PIO courses — see the 'application requirements' link for details and plan ahead to meet those requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: NDPTC social media courses for disaster response and recovery
rubrics_metrics.description: National Disaster Preparedness Training Center courses relevant to PIOs: Social Media for Natural Disaster Response and Recovery (PER-304); Social Media Tools and Techniques (PER-344); Social Media Engagement Strategies (PER-343).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: View the NDPTC course delivery schedule for offerings; these courses focus specifically on social media use in disaster contexts and complement FEMA/DEM PIO curricula.
